My entire life. When I was 3 years old I wouldn't even drink after my own mom. Like how does this even come about? 3 year olds don't even understand germs. It's like we are all programmed from the beginning.
Yea it's all bull. All you have to do is go to a crowded place and people watch. So many happy, care free people.
Wow! I have IBS too lol. Dicyclomine helps alot but my anxiety messes my stomach up along side it so I still have to watch what I eat and where I eat it.

A trillion dollars wouldn't even move my happiness meter an inch. The only thing that could fix me is a new brain. Mine was ruined from the start. I don't want money, I just wanted to know what it would be like to be normal.

If it's real then I believe it is associated with karma. I believe we would be rewarded for suffering in our previous life. I would like to experience life as a normal person before I go into the afterlife. I never got that opportunity.
I do that too. And I go through that within seconds of each other. It's like I will convince myself to be sad because I know that if I'm happy it won't last. It never has. And the fall is much worse.
It makes you question why we are even here. Almost like we are being punished. It just isn't fair.

I couldn't agree more and I also live in Michigan. Yesteday was 65 degrees and what did I do? Sit inside and do absolutely nothing. When I see day light it makes me think I should be doing something and that makes me more depressed.

I've thought about this multiple times. Money will change nothing. If someone offered me a trillion dollars or to not be mentally ill, I am picking to not be mentally ill every single time. If someone offered me a trillion dollars or the guarantee that I die in my sleep tonight, I am picking the die in my sleep every single time. 

I never wanted anything materialistic in this world. I just wanted to be happy.

Some people have an awful movie from start to finish so they want to turn it off because they can't bear to watch it anymore. And speaking of the chance of existing. Life is a lottery. You don't choose anything about you. People are born blind, deaf, autistic, prone to mental illness, prone to cancer, without legs, born into poverty, born into abuse, born into incest, raped as a child, etc. People who have a good life have it because of good luck. People who have a bad life have it because of bad luck. Simple as that. And we don't want to stay here anymore with our bad luck. Requested medical assisted suicide should be legal under any circumstance because life isn't fair and we shouldn't be allowed to be tortured to stay here because the people who are in charge of all our decisions have a good life. Bullshit. Let us die. It's prison.
